description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and the Macro-F1 Score, comparing two different approaches. The x-axis represents the number of tokens, with a linear scale, ranging from approximately 0.6 to 1.4, and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis represents the Macro-F1 Score in percentage, also on a linear scale, ranging from 48 to 58, with tick labels at intervals of 2. The plot contains two lines: the pink line, labeled "MATTER (ours)", has a solid style with circle markers, and the purple line, labeled "w/o material information", also has a solid style with circle markers. The pink line starts at around 55% at 0.6 tokens, peaks at approximately 60% at 0.9 tokens, and then declines to around 55% at 1.4 tokens, with a notable fluctuation between 0.7 and 1.1 tokens. The purple line begins at around 53% at 0.6 tokens, remains relatively stable until 1.2 tokens where it is around 55.5%, and then drops to approximately 51% at 1.4 tokens, with a slight increase to around 57% at 1.3 tokens before the drop. Both lines have shaded regions around them, indicating the range of values.
